elements.name: wide night view of busy avenue
pavements packed with people as dark shapes
tall concrete buildings with many lit windows
young man small in lower frame seen from behind

anatomy: The young man carries an extra black bag that merges with a stray bicycle-handlebar shape at the bottom edge; his legs and feet are partly lost in it.
notes: Make the man small, centred and seen squarely from behind in sandals with dark brown skin and only one backpack, remove the extra bag and handlebar, blank out all shop-sign lettering, and add red tail lights.
